Some messages, he thought, arrive exactly when they are needed.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市陷入最深的沉默。路灯把橘黄色的光洒在空旷的柏油路上，偶尔一辆出租车划过，尾灯拉出两道红色的线。早点铺的灯亮了，老板娘揉着面团，蒸笼里升起白色的雾气。环卫工人推着车走过街角，扫帚在地面划出沙沙的声响。远处高楼上几扇窗还亮着——也许是加班的程序员，也许是失眠的老人。天际线隐约泛出一丝灰蓝，鸟还没有醒来，而整座城市正像一个翻了个身的人，在梦与醒的边缘轻轻呼吸。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a simple version of the problem it can answer right away without calling itself again, so it doesn't keep going forever.\n• Example: to add up the numbers 1 through 5, you say \"5 plus the sum of 1 through 4,\" and to get that you say \"4 plus the sum of 1 through 3,\" and so on until you reach 1, which you just know is 1."}
